FIRE Planner

Privacy Policy

Effective 29 September 2026 · Published by Logic Agent LLC

FIRE Planner is a retirement planner available at fire-planner.in (“the website”) and as an app for iPhone, iPad and Mac (“the app”). It is built so that your financial information stays with you. We do not collect, store or sell your personal or financial data.

What we collect

Nothing about you or your plan. There are no accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking in the website or the app.

Where your plan is kept

  • App: your plan, goals, check-ins and scenarios are stored only on your device, protected by your device passcode or Face ID, and excluded from iCloud backup. A short summary without any money amounts (countdown date, ages and percentages) is shared with the app’s own widgets on the same device.
  • Website: calculations happen in your browser. Your plan is kept only for the current session unless you turn on “Save on this browser”, which stores it in your browser’s local storage on that device.

Moving your plan

“Copy plan data” and “Share plan data” create text containing your numbers. It goes only where you paste or send it. Treat it as private.

Services we rely on

  • Apple: purchases of FIRE Planner Pro are made and verified by Apple through the App Store. We receive no payment details and no financial data. See Apple’s Privacy Policy.
  • Hosting: the website is served by GitHub Pages, which may process standard connection information such as IP addresses to deliver the site. See GitHub’s Privacy Statement.
  • Exchange rates (website only): if you choose “Get latest reference rate”, the website asks Frankfurter for a rate, sending only the two currency codes.

Deleting your data

Because your data never reaches us, you delete it directly: in the app use More → Reset to the sample plan, or delete the app; on the website use Settings → Reset, or clear this site’s data in your browser.

Children

FIRE Planner is intended for adults and does not knowingly collect information from anyone.

Changes

If this policy changes, we will update this page and its effective date.

Contact
